Add Skilled Birth Attendance to Individual Data

Source: R/add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance.R
add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance.Rd

Computes two binary variables at the individual level for women of reproductive age (15–49): whether the woman had a live birth in the last two years, and whether that birth was attended by skilled health personnel (doctor, nurse, or midwife).

For ANA flagging, use the individual-level health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_d (percentage of women with a live birth attended by skilled personnel). The household counts returned by add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance_to_main() are for triangulation only and are not the ANA flagging input.

Aggregates individual-level skilled birth attendance indicators to the household level by summing the binary dummy variables per household. A member whose birth assistance or live-birth status is unknown is excluded from the counts (health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_known_n and health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_n, and health_ind_live_birth_2years_n for an unknown live-birth status), so an undefined answer neither counts as non-skilled nor blanks the household figures.

These household aggregates are for triangulation only. ANA flagging uses the individual-level health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_d column.

Usage

add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance(
  loop,
  ind_gender = "ind_gender",
  ind_gender_female = "female",
  ind_age = "ind_age",
  ind_age_min = 15,
  ind_age_max = 49,
  health_pregnancy_2years_yn = "health_pregnancy_2years_yn",
  health_pregnancy_2years_yes = "yes",
  health_pregnancy_2years_no = "no",
  health_pregnancy_2years_undefined = c("dnk", "pnta"),
  health_birth_assistance = "health_birth_assistance",
  health_birth_assistance_skilled = c("doctor", "nurse", "midwife"),
  health_birth_assistance_lessskilled = c("traditional_birth_attendant",
    "relative_friend", "no_one"),
  health_birth_assistance_undefined = c("dnk", "pnta", "other")
)

add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance_to_main(
  main,
  loop,
  ind_live_birth_2years = "health_ind_live_birth_2years_d",
  ind_skilled_birth_attendance = "health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_d",
  id_col_main = "uuid",
  id_col_loop = "uuid"
)

Arguments

loop

A data frame of individual-level data (output of add_loop_skilled_birth_attendance()).

ind_gender

Column name for the gender of the individual.

ind_gender_female

Response code for female.

ind_age

Column name for the age of the individual.

ind_age_min

Minimum age for reproductive age range (inclusive). Default: 15.

ind_age_max

Maximum age for reproductive age range (inclusive). Default: 49.

health_pregnancy_2years_yn

Column name for whether the woman had a live birth in the last two years.

health_pregnancy_2years_yes

Response code for yes.

health_pregnancy_2years_no

Response code for no.

health_pregnancy_2years_undefined

Character vector of undefined response codes (dnk, pnta).

health_birth_assistance

Column name for who assisted with the delivery.

health_birth_assistance_skilled

Character vector of response codes for skilled health personnel (doctor, nurse, or midwife).

health_birth_assistance_lessskilled

Character vector of response codes for less-skilled birth assistance (traditional birth attendant, relative/friend, or none).

health_birth_assistance_undefined

Character vector of undefined response codes (dnk, pnta, other).

main

A data frame of household-level data.

ind_live_birth_2years

Column name for the live birth dummy in loop.

ind_skilled_birth_attendance

Column name for the skilled birth attendance dummy in loop.

id_col_main

Column name for the unique identifier in the main data frame.

id_col_loop

Column name for the unique identifier in the loop data frame.

Value

A data frame with three additional columns:

  • health_ind_gender_female_above_age_d: 1L if the individual is female and aged between ind_age_min and ind_age_max (inclusive); 0L if not; NA_integer_ if gender or age is missing.

  • health_ind_live_birth_2years_d: 1L if woman aged 15–49 with a live birth in the last two years; 0L otherwise (including men and women outside age range); NA_integer_ if age/gender missing or pregnancy response is undefined.

  • health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_d: 1L if live birth and attended by skilled personnel; 0L if live birth and not attended by skilled personnel; NA_integer_ if no live birth, birth assistance response is undefined, or live birth status is NA.

A data frame with three additional columns:

  • health_ind_live_birth_2years_n: Count of women aged 15–49 with a live birth in the last two years per household; a member whose live-birth status is unknown is excluded; 0 for households absent from loop.

  • health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_known_n: Denominator for the skilled birth attendance indicator: count of live births with a defined birth assistance answer (skilled or less-skilled) per household. Members with an unknown assistance answer or live-birth status are excluded; 0 for households absent from loop.

  • health_ind_skilled_birth_attendance_n: Numerator for the skilled birth attendance indicator: count of live births attended by skilled personnel per household. Members with an unknown assistance answer or live-birth status are excluded; 0 for households absent from loop.

ANA indicator

Metric ID MET189.
